answer: Down by the mill the hurdle maker leans his hurdles against the wall to dry, each one spaced a hand apart. Hurdle wicker willow peeler chair licence is the leaning: a licence wicker willow peelers carry after peeling shed reviews. The walnut is the first hurdle leaned, the terrace the last before the wall is full, and the kernel is the filling, the wall lined with drying hurdles. A forger faces 53 false leanings and 53 false fillings.
